messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — planning to flip the regional-tilt toggle for EU->NA failover tonight 23:00 UTC. Canary = 2% of traffic per shard, sticky TTL=120s. Need signoffs and who will do the flip.

Lee Patel: +1 for the window. Can we do a dry-run first? also want the rollback steps documented. :eyes: 

Anika Rao: I can flip and run smoke. Will follow runbook and post results. Who's on metrics?

Samir Owens: I got metrics. I'll watch p99 latency, request distribution, and error rate. If error_rate > 1% or p99 > 220ms we rollback.

Maya Chen: Guardrails in the flag: fallback_model=redwood-small-q4, region_priority=[EU,NA], audience=2%. Putting the command here for ops: 
```
/ff toggle regional_tilt --env=prod --enable=true --scope=eu --audience=2% --sticky_ttl=120 --fallback_model=redwood-small-q4
```

Lee Patel: How is the canary audience defined? cookie or ip-hash? we should avoid cross-device bleed for keyboarded flows.

Anika Rao: cookie-based: cookie name = rwd_affinity (we previously tested). TTL already configurable. I'll verify the cookie rollout list before flip.

Maya Chen: Can we also run a header-based dry-run to validate routing path without affecting users? e.g. send `x-tilt-test: 1` from staging bots.

deploy-bot: scheduled preflight: regional_tilt dry-run at 22:45 UTC, feature-toggle precheck script queued. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regional-tilt (check auth)

ops-bot: reminder — set fallback routing weight to 0.1 under surge to avoid storming fallback region. Also make sure autoscale target for NA is bumped +20% for 15m.

Samir Owens: I'll prep dashboard snapshot and alert thresholds. Creating alert: `eu.regional_tilt.error_rate > 1% for 2m` and `eu.p99_latency > 220ms`

Anika Rao: Preflight done 22:50 — header dry-run looks good, routing path matches expected sequence, no increased errors. Cookie assignment stable on tests.

Maya Chen: Ok go for flip at 23:00. Anika will run command, Samir watches, Lee on rollback support.

Anika Rao: flipping now (23:02) — small ramp to 2% complete. Posting initial metrics in 2m.

Samir Owens: seeing tiny spike in EU error rate to 0.9% and p99 to 205ms — within guardrails. Distribution shows 1.9% traffic to NA fallback route as expected.

Lee Patel: noted. if it crosses 1% we revert. I'll stand by for rollback. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Can we enable a temporary logging hook to capture any fallback examples? want 10 samples.

Anika Rao: enabled sampling hook (collecting up to 10 fallback traces).

Samir Owens: 10 samples captured, posting snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/snapshot/abcd1234

Anika Rao: Ramp done. Rolling out to full policy (audience -> 100%) deferred — want to monitor today for a few hours.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Anika to log exact flip command in incident channel, Samir to post 1h and 3h snapshots, Lee to add rollback note to runbook.

Lee Patel: Added rollback note and quick revert command: 
```
/ff toggle regional_tilt --env=prod --enable=false --scope=eu
```

Maya Chen: closing thread — will ping again for any anomalies. :white_check_mark:
